s: strI, (saptan + wittvAt NIp .) tiTiviSezaH । candrasya saptamakalAkriyA । tatra Suklapakze amftapUrttyavacCinnasaptamakalAkriyA । kfzRa pakze tu amftahrAsAnukUlasaptamakalAkriyeti viSezaH । kozWIpadIpaH ॥ * ॥ aTa saptamI । sA ca zazWIyutA grAhyA yugmAt । pEWInasivacanAcca । yaTA, -- “paYcamI saptamI cEva daSamI ca trayodaSI । pratipannavamI cEva karttavyA sAMmuKI tiTiH ॥” sAMmuKyamuktaM skAnde । “sAMmuKyaM nAma sAyAhnavyApinI dfSyate yadA .” ataeva paradine trisanDyakAlAvyApitve zazWIyuktasaptamyAmupavAsamAha BavizyapurARam । “zazWIsametA karttavyA saptamI nAzwamIyutA । pataNgopAsanAyeha zazWyAmAhurupozaRam ॥” yaTA upozaRe taTA karmmAntare । taTA । “zazWyA yutA saptamI ca karttavyA sarvadA tiTiH । zazWI ca saptamI yatra tatra sannihito hariH ॥” iti skandapurARAt ॥ taTA । “Suklapakzasya saptamyAM sUryyavAro yadA Bavet । saptamI vijayA nAma tatra dattaM mahAPalam ॥” Bavizye । “SAlitaRqulaprasTasya kuryyAdannaM susaMskftam । sUryyAya carukaM dattvA saptamyAYca viSezataH ॥ yAvantastaRqulAstasminnEvedye parisaMKyayA । tAvadvarzasahasrARi sUryyaloke mahIyate ॥” gopaTabrAhmaRam । “dvAtriMSatpalikaM prasTamuktaM svayamaTarvvaRA ॥” jyotize । “palantu lOkikErmmAnEH sAzwarattidvimAzakam । tolakatritayaM jYeyaM jyotirjYEH smftisammatam ॥” tena catUrattikADikamAzapaYcakADikazaqaDikaSatatolakamitAH prasTataRqulAH । iti । evaYcEtannyU nADikayoH PalatAratamyaM boDyam । evaM devatAntare'pi tattallokamahitatvaPalena kalpayituM yuktam । ataeva Sive'pyevaM vakzyate ॥ * ॥ varAhapurARe । “aTAparaM mahArAja vratamAromyasaMjYitam । kaTayAmi paraM puRyaM sarvvapApapraRASanam ॥ tasyEva mAGamAsasya saptamyAM samupozitaH । pUjayedBAskaraM devaM vizRurUpaM sanAtanam ॥ Aditya BAskara rave BAno sUryya divAkara । praBAkareti saMpUjyo devaH sarvveSvaro raviH ॥ zazWyAYcEkakftAhAraH saptamyAM samupozitaH । azwamyAYcEva BuYjIta eza eva viDiH smftaH ॥ anena vatsaraM pUrRaM viDinA yo'rccayedravim । tasyArogyaM DanaM DAnyamiha janmani jAyate ॥ paratra ca SuBaM sTAnaM yadgatvA na nivarttate .” saptamyAM samupozita iti AdikarmmaRi ktaH । tena saptamyAM samupavastumArabDavAnityarTaH । tataSca prAtaH saptamyAmevopavAsasaNkalpaH । raviSca vizRurUpatayA pUjAkAle DyeyaH । aBilApe tu tattiTAvityuktvA AraByeti EhikArogyaDanaDAnyapAralOkikaSuBasTAnalABakAmaH saMvatsaraM yAvadArogyavratamiti viSezaH । tataH praBftisaptamyAmupavAsaM kurvvan । “Aditya BAskara rave BAno sUryya divAkara । praBAkara namastuByaM asmAdrogAdvimocaya ॥” iti mantreRa pUjayet । atra zazWyAdizu tattatkarmmaviDAnAt zazWIsametetyasya na vizayaH । kAlikApurARe BaktaM prati sUryyavAkyam । “adfzwvA mAM na BuYjIta viRmUtraM nEva darSayet ॥” taTA । “madarccADftanirmmAlyaM SarIre na tu DArayet ॥” arccA pratimA ॥ * ॥ aTa viDAnasaptamI । kftyacintAmaRO । “arkAgraM Suci gomayaM sumaricaM toyaM PalaYcASnute mUlaM naktamupozaRaYca viDivat kftvEkaBaktaM naraH । kzIraM vAyvaSanaM GftASanamiti proktAnyamUni kramAt kftvA dvAdaSa saptamIrdinakftaH prApnotyaBIzwaM Palam ॥” atra cArkAgrAdItaraBojananivfttiravasIyate । tapastvAt । taTA ca matsyapurARam । “tapoBiH prApyate'BIzwaM nAsADyaM hi tapasyataH । durBagatvaM vfTA loko vahate sati sADane ॥” tapasaH kleSasvaBAvatvaM tatrEvoktam । “ume'ticapalA puttri na kzamaM tAvakaM vapuH । soQuM kleSasvaBAvasya tapasaH sOmyadarSane ॥” vyaktamuktaM yaTA, -- “arkapatrANkuramAtramantarIkzagfhItakam । kapilAviqyavamAtraM maYjulaM maricaM jalam ॥ kadalIPalamaDyantu kaRAmAtramapakvakam । kuSamUlaM yavamAtraM svacCAyAdviguRe kzaRe ॥ BakzyaM mitOdanaM naktaM SudDopavasanaM taTA । ekaBaktaM mayUrARqapramARaM BojanaM matam ॥ ardDaprasftiBAtrantu kapilAdugDaBakzaRam । snAtvA sampUjya mArttaRqaM prANmuKo vAyumASayet ॥ vftaM svalpaM pOzamAse mAGAdabdaM samAcaret । brAhmaRAn BojayedBaktyA guqakzIranirAmizEH ॥ viprAya dakziRA deyA viBavasyAnurUpataH । azwamyAM pAraRaM kuryyAt kawvamlarahitena ca ॥ mudgamAzatilAdIni GftaYcEva vivirjjayet । ekasidDaM BakzyamuktamarkatantrAnusArataH ॥” * ॥ etadvratasya mADAdiBAsaviSezavihitakarmmatvena malamAsetarakarttavyatvaM Aha vaSizWaliNgapurARam । “prArabDe tu vrate paScAt samprApte tvaDimAsake । pUrvvamAnena taM tyaktvA kAryyaM dvAdaSamAsikam ॥” pUrvvamAnena malimlucaSUnyAbdamAnena । taM malamAsam । dvAdaSamAsekaM dvAdaSamAsezveva kAryyaM na malamAsa ityarTaH । yattu । “mAse malimluce'pyevaM yajeddevIM saSaNkarAm । kintu nodyApanaM kAryyamityAha BagavAn SivaH ॥” hati vizRurahasyavacanam ॥ tanmAsaviSezAnaNkitamAsamAtrakattavyAmAvAsyAdivratakarttavyatAparam । udyApanaM pratizWA । evamAramBo'pi nizidDaH । gArgyaH । “astaM gate gurO Sukre bAle vfdDe malimlu ce । upAyanamupAramBaM vratAnAM nEva kArayet ॥” upAyanaM pratizWA । upAramBamAramBam । enacca kAlASudDimAtraparaM tattanmAtraviDikalpane gOravAt ॥ * ॥ Bavizye । “BAdre mAsi site pakze saptamyAM niyamena yA । snAtvA SivaM leKayitvA maRqale ca sahAmbikam pUjayecca tadA tasyA duzprApaM nEva vidyate ॥” idaM kukkuwIvratatvena KyAtam ॥ * ॥ Bavizye । “sUryyagrahaRatulyA hi SuklA mAGasya saptamI । aruRodayavelAyAM tasyAM snAnaM mahAPalam ॥ mAGe mAsi site pakze saptamI kowiBAskarA । dadyAt snAnArGya dAnAByAmAyurArogyasampadaH ॥ aruRodayavelAyAM SuklA mAGasya saptamI । gaNgAyAM yadi laByeta sUryyagrahaSatEH samA ॥” kowiBAskarA kowisaptamItulyA । sUryyagrahaRaPalaM snAnajaM sannihite budDirantaraNgeti nyAyAt tena bahuSatasUryyagrayaRakAlInagaNgAsnAnajanyaPalasamaPalaprAptiH Palamatra jYeyam । atra bahuSatasUryyagrahARAM pratyekADikaraRatAsaMsargeRAnvayAt kAlAnAM snAnAnAM tatPalAnAmapi bahuSatatvaM laByate ato nAprasidDiH । pUrRasaptamyAM pUrvva parayoryatrAruRodayakAle saptamI pUrvva dine tatkAle snAnam । “catasro GawikA prAtararuRodaya ucyate । yatInAM snAnakAlo'yaM gaNgAmBaHsadfSaH smftaH ॥ triyAmAM rajanIM prAhustyaktvAdyantacatuzwayam । nAqInAM taduBe sanDye divasAdyantasaMjYite ॥” iti kAlalADavIyaDftabrahmavEvarttIyena pUrvvasya tatkAlasya pUrvvatiTisambanDidinakarttavyakarmmANga tvena itarasya cetarANgatvenABiDAnAt ataeva dakzeRa tatkAlamAraByAhnikakftyamaBihitam । atrAruRodayakAle muhUrttAnyU natiTilABa eva snAnam । “vratopavAsasnAnAdO GawikEkA yadA Bavet । udaye sA tiTirgrAhyA SrAdDAdAvastagAminI ॥” iti vizRuDarmmottarAt । pratra GawikA muhUrttaM SrAdDayogyakAlAnuroDAt iti vakzyate । brahmavEvarttavacane GawikA daRqarUpA paravacane nAqInAmAdyantacatuzwayamityekavAkyatvAt ॥ * ॥ ye tu sUryyodayAt prAgapi prAtaHsnAnaviDAnAt tatrEva mAGasaptamyAKyaguRaPalaviDirlAGavAdityAhustaccintyam । prakaraRAnyatve prayojanAnyatvaM iti jEminisUtreRa prakaraRaBede guRaviDyasidDeH । ataeva kalpataruratnAkarayoH । “ya icCedvipulAn BogAn candrasUryyagrahopamAn । prAtaHsnAyI BavennityaM dvO mAsO mAGaPAlgunO ॥” iti vizRusmftO nityasnAnaprakaraRAt prakaraRAntarAsnAnAt prakaraRAntarADikaraRanyAyena kAmyasnAnAntaramidamityuktaM na tu guRaPalaviDiH । kintu kAmyakaraRe prasaNgAnnityasidDiriti । atra mAGamAsanimittakamAGasaptamInimittakakAmyasnAnayoH prAtarvviDAnAt nEmittikatvena prAyaScittavat sakfdanuzWAnam । “praDAnasyAkriyA yatra sANgaM tat kriyate punaH । tadaNgasyAkriyAyAntu nAvfttirna ca tatkriyA ॥” iti kAtyAyanavacanAt ॥ “na snAnagAcaredBuktvA nAturo na mahAniSi । na vAsoBiH sahAjasraM nAvijYAte jalASaye ॥” iti manuvacanenEkadAjasrasnAnanizeDAcca । “DarmmavinnAcaret snAnamAhnikaYca punaHpunaH .” iti manuvacanAcca । ataeva nAndImuKaprakaraRaSeze praDAnAnAmapi kAmyAnAM
